Q_answer_a_sync_update: All 16 agents share one actor and one critic network. Within each PPO update step, all 16 agents are optimized jointly: the inner loop iterates over N_AGENTS inside each mini-batch forward pass. One _ppo_update() call per batch_size=256 episodes.
Q_answer_b_warmup: No warmup: PPO has no replay buffer, so the first batch of 256 episodes immediately triggers a PPO update. First observed flip: update_step=0, episode=256.
Q_answer_c_eval: Evaluation: stochastic sampling via actor.action_sampler (Categorical.sample). 9 independent trials. reward = mean over 9 trials. loads column in main.csv = loads from the 9th (last) trial, NOT the mode. eval_ippo.csv stores all 9 trials for the last 10 checkpoints only. Greedy reference (flips) = argmax logit per agent, separate from eval.
